HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOOLHEYAK.description:
A feathered serpent seeking history and truth.
To uncover the ancient secrets buried deep within the Spire, she gracefully steps into this endless cage.
She once attempted to go against the currents, but has now made up her mind to go with the tide.
